$comment: NEW-52: the 20 test phrases of the exponentialTalk spike. Ten German, ten English, each with the identifiers, thread titles and command words the dispatcher must hear right. `ref` is the reference transcript WER is scored against (lower-cased, punctuation stripped by the scorer; identifiers kept as spoken tokens). The synthetic set is generated from these by the TTS engines under test; `scripts/record.sh` records a human set with the same ids. `spoken` is the form a person says aloud (identifiers spelled, numbers as words); it is what the TTS engines synthesise and what WER is scored against; turning `E X P twelve forty two` back into `EXP-1242` is the Assistant's job, not the recogniser's.
